[
  "The licensed guideline corpus contains no recommendation for 'NEV'.",
  "Formal dermatology guidelines focus on malignant and pre‑malignant lesions.",
  "The absence of a recommendation for 'NEV' is a coverage boundary of the corpus, not a retrieval failure.",
  "The guideline for melanoma (MEL) is covered in the corpus.",
  "The guideline for melanoma includes a recommendation for initial local management.",
  "According to PMID 30392755, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "According to PMID 30392755, sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor when indicated, and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "According to PMID 39709737, when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1‑3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as those on the face, acral lesions, and genitalia.",
  "The recommendation in PMID 39709737 has a consensus rate of 100% (21/21).",
  "The override increased the 7‑point score from 4 to 6 but did not change the verdict, which remains excision."
]
